rationale:
ROUND 2 on the per-slot shrink guard (round 1 REVISE, gating HIGH from debug_historian). The code is live — commits 2da3e08e5 (guard) and 5f00dcba9 (this round's locked-slot correction), running in v1.0.1233 and re-verified after the v1.0.1234 roll — so per the owner ruling of 2026-07-29 this is the after-the-fact review the platform actually supports. Every round-1 objection is answered below, most with measurements run since; the HIGH is answered by a live induction with the prediction recorded before the outcome.

THE DEFECT (unchanged from round 1): the page-total content regression guard refuses only a near-wipe (<25% of the page's text), so a regeneration gutting ONE prose slot passes twice over — the loss is diluted by intact siblings, and 25% is a wipe threshold, not a shrink threshold. Measured 2026-08-02: a 'add a tool reference' item cut robot-hands' article slot by 57% (page total −24%) and reported complete; the same shape had already cost vetcomparison 70% of its FAQ and fundamentallyai a 32KB tool source. The guard compares slot against same-named slot, stripped of tags, and refuses the save when a prose-sized slot (≥500 stripped chars) keeps less than section_shrink_floor (default 0.5, per-step config, 0 disables, clamped). Refusal writes nothing and emits a durable refusal work item.

ANSWER TO THE GATING HIGH (debug_historian: 'the guard may refuse internally while the orchestration reports green and stale content deploys anyway'): answered empirically, not by argument. Induction 2026-08-02 22:54–22:59Z on dartsonline /blog/beginners.html (the fix loop's own example site; all four dispatch gates verified, zero open items, no open refusal item to collide with dedup). Method: the stored side of one prose slot (article-body) was inflated to 15,443 stripped chars (md5-guarded UPDATE, full 3-slot backup first); a page_rerender work item was queued through the platform's own dispatcher — no hand-fired action, the real path end to end. Success criteria were written into NOTES_work_item_routing_columns.md BEFORE the outcome. Results, all four criteria met: (1) TWO independent orchestration attempts (33fded0c 22:56:00Z, 085bcb22 22:58:34Z) both terminated FAILED at save_sections with the full refusal in orchestration_states.error — on this path the refusal is NOT masked green; (2) the refusal work item save_refused_incomplete:beginners (ebc1dda8) was emitted at the FIRST refusal with status needs_human_review, and the second attempt's emit was collapsed by idx_swi_dedup exactly as designed — one open item per site+key, no churn; (3) NOTHING was written: all three page_components rows byte-identical to baseline (md5 + updated_at), ZERO new page_component_history rows, deploy_page never reached, so no stale deploy is possible — the deploy step is downstream of the refused save; (4) the induction item never went complete. For handler paths that DO wrap step errors in complete_error (the sibling page-total guard's documented masking, 016 back-catalogue), the work item is the unconditional visibility channel: the guard writes it itself, in its own transaction, before returning the error — masking can hide the STATUS but not the EVENT, and the damage vector is closed either way because a refusal writes nothing. Induction fully cleaned up: slot restored byte-exact (md5 82707c59… re-verified), marker grep across page_components = 0 rows, both work items cancelled with the reason recorded.

ANSWERS TO THE MEDIUMS. (guardian, blast radius): measured, not asserted — SIX live agent types invoke save_page_sections as an action: page-build-handler, page-rerender, tool-recreation-handler (top-level save_sections step) plus pageflow-builder, page-rebuild, site-work-orchestrator (nested sub-workflow steps, which a top-level step scan misses). council-gate, diagnose-agent and fix-proposer match a raw config grep only via reviewer footprint maps — mention, not invocation. Zero live step configs set section_shrink_floor today, so the 0.5 default governs all six; each can opt down or out per step. (guardian, green-means-saved consumers): the FIRST refusal path on this action already broke that assumption and the landmine is recorded; this guard adds a second refusal to the SAME idiom — a consumer correct about the completeness floor's refusal is correct about this one, and the measured path (page-rerender) demonstrably reports FAILED, not green. (editquality, fundamentallyai NULL shape): the NULLed-content_data case is cited as class motivation, not as a case this guard closes. Which shape a NULLing writer produces on entry is the upstream writer's property, not this guard's: if the slot arrives present-with-empty, this guard fires (0 < floor×existing); if it arrives absent, that is a DROP and the completeness floor's territory — with a stated residual: dropping 1 of 3 slots is a 0.67 cohort ratio, above that floor's 0.5 default, a gap that belongs to the floor's ratio and is recorded in bugs_open/178, not silently absorbed here. (bug_historian, other writers unguarded): true and known — ApplySectionEditAction and the other rendered_html writers are named in bugs_open/178, which stays OPEN for the class; this commit guards the chokepoint that every measured incident actually went through (all three loss events have save_page_sections overwrite rows in page_component_history). (debug_historian, no deploy-verification step): done and named — three-grep pod verification in one exec per replica, BOTH replicas: marker 'SECTION SHRINK' (≥1, observed 2), config key 'section_shrink_floor' (≥1, observed 1), positive control 'CONTENT REGRESSION BLOCKED' (≥1, observed 1), negative control 0 — run on v1.0.1233 and re-run after the v1.0.1234 roll, same numbers.

ANSWERS TO THE LOWS. (prior_art_librarian, locked slots): CORRECT, and fixed in code this round (5f00dcba9): the existing-side query now excludes non-agent-writable rows via pageComponentAgentWritableSQL("") — the same canonical predicate loadActiveLockedRows uses. For a locked slot the save DISCARDS the incoming copy and the locked row stands (bugs_open/058), so this save cannot shrink it, and comparing the discarded incoming against the locked existing is precisely the sibling floor's documented false-refusal trap. (bug_historian, residual sub-500 gap): accepted risk, now stated in the plan explicitly: a sub-500-char prose slot, or a shrink that keeps ≥50%, can still lose text with no refusal. The 500 bound is measured, not aesthetic — every measured loss was ≥1,880 stripped chars, and the measured LEGITIMATE large shrink (gamesdesign hero, −70%, an improvement) lived in exactly the sub-500-per-slot / hero-sized band the bound exempts. (architecture, three bespoke floors): acknowledged; the guards already share pruneFloorFromConfig, emitPruneRefusalWorkItem and savePageSectionsRefusal, so consolidation has begun at the helper layer; a unified content-loss detector is a design question that should arrive as its own submission when the NEXT variant appears, not as a rider on this fix.

plan.summary: Per-slot shrink floor in SavePageSectionsAction: refuse a save in which a same-named prose slot (≥500 stripped chars, not human-locked) keeps less than section_shrink_floor (default 50%) of its stripped text. Pure decision fn + fail-closed loader + refusal work item, wired after the page-total guard whose wipe threshold and page altitude both missed the 178 losses. Round 2 adds the locked-slot exclusion the prior_art seat asked for and carries the induction, pod-grep and blast-radius evidence the other seats asked for.

edits.rationale: New guard file, shipped in 2da3e08e5: pure decision function evaluateSectionShrink(floor, existingBySlot, incomingBySlot) split from the SQL loader so the rule is unit-testable; enforceSectionShrinkFloor loads per-slot stripped lengths, fails CLOSED on measurement error (matching enforcePageSectionFloor), and emits a refusal work item via the existing emitPruneRefusalWorkItem/savePageSectionsRefusal helpers — reuse, not a new emitter, so recurrenceExpected and dedup semantics are inherited from the already-approved 165 round.

Wire the guard after the page-total regression guard and before the interactivity guard: the page-total guard refuses a near-wipe, this one refuses a single gutted slot the page-total dilution hides. Refusal follows the action's existing semantics — the whole save is refused and nothing is written.

Table test on the pure decision function using the REAL measured numbers from the incidents: the robot-hands 4644→1980 slot must violate, the gamesdesign hero rewrite must not (sub-threshold), growth always passes, a dropped slot is out of scope, floor 0 disables, floor clamps at 0.95.

ROUND 2, answering prior_art_librarian: locked rows are excluded from the existing side with pageComponentAgentWritableSQL("") — the canonical single-source-of-truth predicate. For a locked slot the save discards the incoming copy and the locked row stands (bugs_open/058), so this save cannot shrink it; comparing the discarded incoming against the locked existing could refuse a save that would have damaged nothing — the completeness floor's documented locked-slot trap, closed here the same way. Shipped as 5f00dcba9, verified against git archive HEAD (in-tree build was broken by another session's in-flight edit, not by this change).

grounded_in: THE GUARD GAP, MEASURED (round 1, unchanged): 178's incident was −57% in one slot and −24% page-wide; the existing guard is page-TOTAL with a 25% WIPE threshold — two independent blindnesses, both required for the loss to pass. History rows: robot-hands generic-text-block 4617→1980 stripped (2026-08-02 10:41), vetcomparison faq 7206→2197 (08-01 08:13), fundamentallyai tool slot 32444→NULL (07-30 20:13).

THE INDUCTION, VERBATIM, from orchestration_states.error on BOTH attempts (33fded0c and 085bcb22, 2026-08-02 22:56:00Z and 22:58:34Z, status FAILED): 'step save_sections failed: failed to execute action save_page_sections: save_page_sections: SECTION SHRINK REFUSED for page "beginners" — article-body 15443→4644 chars (30% kept, floor 50%). A same-named prose slot may not lose more than 50% of its text in one save; if this shrink is intended, set section_shrink_floor in the step config. Nothing was written (bugs_open/178).' The 4644 is byte-deterministic: the regeneration reproduced the pre-inflation stripped length exactly.

THE REFUSAL ITEM, OBSERVED: site_work_items ebc1dda8, item_type save_refused_incomplete, item_key save_refused_incomplete:beginners, status needs_human_review, created_by save_page_sections, created 22:56:00.258371Z — 17ms inside the first refusal, before the orchestration row turned FAILED. One item despite two refusals: idx_swi_dedup collapsed the second emit, by design.

NOTHING WRITTEN, MEASURED: after two refused saves, all three page_components rows md5- and updated_at-identical to the pre-induction backup; page_component_history rows for the page since induction start: 0; the article-body row still carried the induced marker (proof the refused save did not overwrite even the slot it objected to). Cleanup then restored the slot byte-exact (md5 82707c596d600e46f9d61ae7ad1f8919 re-verified) and a fleet-wide marker grep returned 0 rows.

PREDICTION BEFORE OUTCOME: the four success criteria (refusal text with the computed numbers, emitted work item with the exact item_key, zero writes, item never complete) were appended to NOTES_work_item_routing_columns.md before the work item was inserted — the lane's standing discipline since the 154 witness.

BLAST RADIUS, THE QUERY AND THE ANSWER: SELECT ad.type FROM agent_definitions ad, LATERAL jsonb_each(ad.default_config->'workflow'->'steps') s WHERE ad.is_active AND COALESCE(ad.is_snapshot,false)=false AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.value->>'action'='save_page_sections' → page-build-handler, page-rerender, tool-recreation-handler; a raw-text pass over the same live definitions adds pageflow-builder, page-rebuild, site-work-orchestrator via '"action": "save_page_sections"' inside nested sub_workflow steps, and shows council-gate/diagnose-agent/fix-proposer matching only as footprint-map MENTIONS (invokes_as_action=false). Six invokers total; zero step configs set section_shrink_floor.

POD VERIFICATION, RUN TWICE: strings /app/agent-chassis | grep -c — 'SECTION SHRINK' 2, 'section_shrink_floor' 1, control 'CONTENT REGRESSION BLOCKED' 1, negative control 0; both replicas, one exec each, on v1.0.1233 (2026-08-02 ~22:15Z) and again on v1.0.1234 (2026-08-02 ~22:45Z, pods 40–63s old at check).

THE LOCKED-SLOT MECHANISM, from save_page_sections_action.go (bugs_open/058 block): locked rows are preloaded, excluded from the DELETE, and an incoming section matching a locked slot is DISCARDED — 'the locked copy stands, only its position moves'. Therefore a locked slot is unreachable by this save's writes, and the guard must not measure it.
plan.risks:
FAIL-CLOSED ON MEASUREMENT ERROR means a transient DB error refuses a legitimate save. Accepted and inherited deliberately from the completeness floor's reviewed design: the save retries with the work item, and a guard that cannot measure must not wave a destructive overwrite through. The refusal work item makes any systematic recurrence queue-visible.

FALSE REFUSAL ON A LEGITIMATELY LARGE CUT is the real behavioural cost: an item that intends to halve a big prose slot is refused until its step config sets section_shrink_floor lower (0 disables). The refusal text names the exact key, and the config is per-step, so the escape hatch is local, not fleet-wide. Measured today: zero configs set it, and the only measured legitimate large shrink (gamesdesign hero) is structurally exempt via the 500-char band.

RESIDUAL GAPS, STATED NOT HIDDEN: (a) sub-500-char prose slots and shrinks keeping ≥50% pass silently — bounded by every measured loss being ≥1,880 chars; (b) a DROPPED slot is the completeness floor's case, and that floor's 0.5 ratio leaves the 1-of-3-slots drop (0.67) unguarded — recorded in bugs_open/178; (c) other writers of rendered_html (ApplySectionEditAction et al.) remain unguarded — 178 stays open for the class and names them; this commit guards the chokepoint all measured incidents used.

COMPLETE_ERROR MASKING on handler paths other than the measured one remains possible for the STATUS — but not for the EVENT (the work item is written by the guard itself before the error returns) and not for the DAMAGE (a refusal writes nothing, and deploy is downstream of the save). A reviewer wanting to verify should repeat the induction on a handler that wraps save_sections in complete_error and confirm the work item still appears.
